name: PayPal Checkout and Card Payments
summary: PayPal takes payments by PayPal Checkout, standard cards and advanced card processing. Checkout costs 3.49% plus 49 cents, standard cards 2.99% plus 49 cents, and advanced cards 2.89% plus 29 cents. Interchange-plus-plus pricing adds 0.49% and 39 cents to pass-through costs. Merchants can move a balance to a bank account, and send batch payouts through a separate product.

facts.text: PayPal Fraud Protection approves legitimate card transactions and declines fraudulent ones using a machine learning engine, and it offers filters, a simulation of filter impact and dashboards.
Fraud Protection is for merchants who have integrated advanced credit and debit card payments, and it is switched on in the PayPal App Center with no extra onboarding.
PayPal Payouts sends batch payments to email addresses, phone numbers or PayPal IDs, across 20+ currencies and 96 countries or regions.
Withdrawing a PayPal balance to a bank account instantly costs 1.50% of the amount, with a $0.50 minimum.
